bio.short: I design products where complex work and everyday decisions have to feel clear. At Bibel TV, I lead a multi-platform consumer redesign and build working prototypes against real APIs. ChurchDesk, Ninox, and Spreadshirt add operational B2B software, design systems, and products connecting business users with consumers.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV, I lead product design across streaming products and the current app redesign. Research changed a dark-first concept into a light-first direction because viewers asked for brightness and readability. The interface, design-token service, and artwork-driven color system now work as one product system. Working prototypes against production APIs give external engineering implementation-ready direction.

At ChurchDesk, I led product management and design for software used by church professionals across six European markets. A funeral-booking project turned phone-based coordination between funeral homes, pastors, and cemeteries into a reusable platform capability. Coordination went from days to hours. That was about 70% less time by my estimate, with 90% booking acceptance. The capability later served other booking workflows.

At Ninox, I owned the design system and established joint governance with Engineering for a no-code business platform. I later designed AI onboarding in which a plain-language prompt generates a database schema directly into the real editor beside chat. The throughline matches Cloover's work: understand unfamiliar operations and make them clear for different levels of technical literacy. Then give engineering a system that is ready to build.

context.company: Cloover builds an AI operating system for installation companies and a consumer product for homeowners making major energy decisions.
context.role: Senior Product Designer: a hands-on role spanning end-to-end product design, polished UI, research, design systems, implementation-ready prototypes, AI-native workflows, and close Product and Engineering collaboration.
context.emphasis: Lead with current consumer craft and operational B2B workflows, then show the implementation bridge through design systems, precise specifications, and working prototypes against real APIs.
